title: Augmenting Human-Centered Racial Covenant Detection and Georeferencing with Plug-and-Play NLP Pipelines

bias_targets.methodology: Detecting racially restrictive language and covenants in historical property deeds using a fine-tuned token-classification model (ModernBERT) and evaluating the model's precision and recall at both the token and document levels against a lexicon-based fuzzy-matching baseline.
